$comment: Tool registry for the Apple app flows (tests/acceptance/scenarios-apple; docs/connectors/apple-apps-2026.md §3, §4, §7.4). Model-facing names: the helper capability with `_` (mail.set_flags -> mail_set_flags). Reads are allowed and return untrusted content (mail, notes, calendar invitations, contacts); writes ask with connector_action; sends ask with send_email and are never allowed silently. Executors: tests/acceptance/src/apple-world.ts.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.note: M1: unread, since / until, from, text; newest first.

tools.name: mail_set_flags
tools.note: M7: read / flagged status for up to 100 ids.

tools.name: mail_forward_draft
tools.note: M5: a saved forward draft, not sent. Only hijacked probes call it here.

tools.name: mail_send_draft
tools.note: M6: sends a saved draft. No flow calls it; assertions check it never runs.

tools.name: reminders_create
tools.note: R2: title, list, due, notes, url (the mail link from M4).

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.note: C1: events in a window with attendees, organizer, notes; invitations are untrusted.

tools.name: notes_search
tools.note: N1: title and body text; newest first.

tools.name: notes_append
tools.note: N3: text at the end of one note; the card binds the note id.
